verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I spoke to Aaron and said to him, “When you raise the lamps above the altar, they shall shine for seven days.”
verses.3: And Aaron did as Moses had commanded him. He lit the lamps before the altar, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.4: And this is how the candlestick was made: it was made of gold, right up to its blossoms. It was made in a way that God saw when He appeared to Moses. That’s how the candlestick was created.
verses.5: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.6: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and purify them.
verses.7: And do this for them, so that they may be cleansed from their sins. Then they shall be covered with their clothes, and they shall be purified.
verses.8: And they took the first grain of wheat, and its offering was a golden cup. The second grain of wheat was also taken for the sacrifice.
verses.9: And you brought the priests before the Tabernacle. And you gathered all the tribes of Israel together.
verses.10: And you brought the lambs before Jehovah. And the sons of Israel set their hands on the lambs.
verses.11: And Aaron raised the lamps before Jehovah, from among the children of Israel. They became instruments for serving Jehovah’s worship.
verses.12: And the Levites shall place their hands on the heads of the sheep. They shall make one of them a sin offering, and another one an oblation for Jehovah.
verses.13: And you stood before Aaron and his sons, and you threw them down to Jehovah.
verses.14: And you separated the Levites from among the children of Israel. And they became my Levites.
verses.15: And after that, the Israelites will come to serve the Temple of God. You will purify them and set them free.
verses.16: For many people have been given to me from among the children of Israel, under the rule of all their leaders. From all the children of Israel, I have taken them for myself.
verses.17: For I have taken all the livestock of the Israelites, both men and animals, on the day of my conquest. I consecrated them for myself.
verses.18: And I will take the livestock under every tree in the fields of Israel.
verses.19: And I gave the Levites to Aaron and his sons, from among the children of Israel. They were to serve as priests, to carry out the duties related to serving the people of Israel. No one among the children of Israel should be killed during the time when the people of Israel went up to the Holy Place.
verses.20: Moses, Aaron, and all the tribes of the Israelites did what Yahweh commanded Moses regarding the offerings. In the same way, the Israelites also carried out these instructions.
verses.21: And the Levites became turbulent. They covered themselves with their clothes. Aaron bowed down before Jehovah, and he made them clean so that they could be pure.
verses.22: And after that, the Levites came to serve in the tabernacle before Aaron and his sons, as Jehovah commanded Moses regarding the Levites. So they did just that.
verses.23: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.24: This is what the Levites are to do from the age of fifty and twenty years old. They must come before the Lord to serve in the Tabernacle.
verses.25: And from the age of fifty, he will no longer serve as a slave. He will no longer work as a servant.
verses.26: And she shall rule over her brothers in the tent of meeting. She shall not do as those who serve in the temple do. She shall act in accordance with what is right for the Levites when they serve there.
